prd.title: PRD: osmani personas as code-quorum lenses (CLAWP-103 handoff)
prd.body_markdown:
## Objective
code-quorum's local PRE-REVIEW pass gains three checklist lenses derived from addyosmani/agent-skills personas, and a mechanical skip rule.

## Why
clawpm CLAWP-103 (ADR docs/design/ADR-2026-09-02-planning-merge-plan.md in martinduncanson/clawpm, rows A2/A3) decided: no persona system anywhere in the stack; personas are checklists and code-quorum's Sonnet PRE-REVIEW is where a checklist earns its keep. This also closes the open question in specs/spec-conformance-lens.md about whether the personas contribute checklist material.

## Constraints
- Adapt the ideas, do not vendor the persona files.
- Lenses are prompt material for the existing local pass, not new surfaces in the quorum table.
- Skip rule must be testable: <=2 files AND <50 changed lines AND no path under auth/payments/data-access/config globs.

## Out of scope
- web-performance-auditor (browser apps only; not a standing lens).
- Any change to the four external surfaces.

## Success definition
PRE-REVIEW output cites the lens that produced each finding; the skip rule is a function with tests; SKILL.md documents both.

## Chosen approach
See objective.

## Open questions
- Whether the security lens should run only when the diff touches its trigger globs (recommended) or always.

## Traceability
Source: osmani-scout report 2026-07-14 (session d94ce3c4) and raw persona files at github.com/addyosmani/agent-skills agents/*.md and .claude/commands/ship.md.

leaves.title: PRE-REVIEW runs security / test-coverage / correctness lens checklists and applies a mechanical skip threshold

success_criteria.criterion: Three lens checklist files exist (security: STRIDE-from-trust-boundaries + OWASP LLM Top 10 items + no-disable-the-control rule; test-coverage: happy/empty/boundary/error/concurrency scenario table + Prove-It for bug fixes; correctness: review tests first, Critical blocks approval), each under 25 lines, and the PRE-REVIEW prompt loads them
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: files present; prompt assembly test shows them included; a sample review output tags findings with lens names

success_criteria.criterion: WHEN a diff has <=2 files AND <50 changed lines AND touches no path matching the sensitive globs THEN the skip function returns skip=true with the reason; any single condition failing returns skip=false naming it
success_criteria.gradeable_signal: unit tests on the boundary (2/3 files, 49/50 lines, one sensitive path)

success_criteria.criterion: SKILL.md documents the lenses and the skip rule; specs/spec-conformance-lens.md open question on personas is marked resolved with a pointer

stop_conditions: If the PRE-REVIEW pass has no prompt-assembly seam to load lens files, STOP and report; do not inline them into SKILL.md prose.

predictions.approach: Read the current PRE-REVIEW invocation in code-quorum; add a lenses/ directory loaded into the prompt; skip rule as a pure function in scripts with tests. UNGROUNDED-GRAPH effort.
predictions.pre_mortem: Lens findings duplicate Codex P2s and inflate noise; tag by lens so divergence analysis can measure it.
